execution.model: set in immutable run manifest before launch

stages.name: environment_validation
requirements: raw interaction and grader artifacts are retained

rules: send the public benchmark instruction as turn 0
answer genuine clarification requests using only public task information
after the first completion claim, demand concrete verification and preservation of ordinary cases
never reveal tests, gold patches, solutions, evaluation criteria, or grader output
one persistent harness session per trial
preserve tool names, arguments, results, and errors

grading.swe_bench: fresh Daytona sandbox using official image and declared F2P/P2P parser
grading.terminal_bench: fresh separate Daytona grader sandbox receiving only declared artifacts
grading.tua_bench: Daytona task sandbox with controller-private tests uploaded only after agent exit
grading.tau3: official task reward/evaluation criteria with fresh task state
